name: Karen Lucs Victoria
original_name: カレン＝ルクス＝ヴィクトリア
source: One of the Star Mikos of the Tower of Destiny, and a third-year. She is a cousin of [url=https://vndb.org/c12399]Seera[/url] from MagusTale, another game made by Whirlpool. Karen is a witch, but she doesn't use magic as magic is prohibited by a rule. However, she can see the future with her magic powers, though the future she can see is only the "possibility of future".
translation: One of the Star Mikos of the Tower of Destiny, and a third-year. She is a cousin of [url=https://vndb.org/c12399]Seera[/url] from MagusTale, another game made by Whirlpool. Karen is a witch, but she doesn't use magic as magic is prohibited by a rule. However, she can see the future with her magic powers, though the future she can see is only the "possibility of future".
